the analysis of the different VaR models and the application of these in the domestic market with the purpose of investment risk quantification.
the analysis of the VaR models and the comparison of different approaches to VaR estimation.

the results of the study confirm the prominent place and importance of different Value at Risk models in the light and context of investment risk quantification, and that they are applicable in decision-making about investments in the domestic market.
the VaR models have a significant place in the investment decision-making process in order to minimize risk, but that their application is not equally successful in all circumstances.

it is an attempt to analyze the possibilities of effective investment risk assessment in the domestic market by using a variety of Value at Risk models.
